rationale: The event trace passes both compliance checks: (1) Ride-through: All samples remain connected with voltage within the envelope constraints (0.55 pu at t=0.05-0.12s is within 0.5 pu minimum for up to 0.7s). (2) Reactive current support: When voltage drops to 0.55 pu at t=0.05s, reactive current reaches 0.25 pu by t=0.12s (within 0.1s response deadline), meeting the 0.2 pu minimum requirement.
